title: Governance OS capability consumption receipt v1
description: Evidence-bearing, non-vacuous record that a capability's side-effect was executed. Mirrors check_go_schema.py R-GATE-EVIDENCE: a real command + output is not enough — the receipt MUST anchor to a commit SHA or a logs/ artifact (the anyOf below). The hand-rolled validate_receipt in scripts/route_capability.py is authoritative; this schema is documentation of the same contract.
